description: This Dart source file defines a mock data repository for quizzes used in an educational or learning application. It contains a static list of quiz catalog objects, each representing a different mock quiz with questions, categories, difficulties, and other metadata. The class provides a helper method to find a quiz by its ID.

classes.name: MockQuizzesData
classes.description: A class providing in-memory mock quiz data, including a static list of quizzes and a method to retrieve a quiz by id.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Locates and returns a quiz catalog matching the given ID, or null if not found.
